title: Cosmic Mosaic of Earth and Stars
content: A detailed mosaic tile artwork depicting Earth from space. The lower half features the curved Earth crafted from blue, green, brown, and white tesserae. The upper half shows a deep blue cosmos filled with golden-yellow stars, a ringed planet, the moon, and a swirling spiral galaxy. Handcrafted ceramic or glass tile texture with visible grout. Vibrant, saturated colors with a glossy, reflective glaze finish.
